items.text: Fixes a player-reported potential soft lock in Jarlshof+, thanks very much for submitting that!
Hey all,
It's been a crazy month-and-a-bit since Into the Restless Ruins came out, and we haven't been sat back sipping cocktails in the sun (partly because we're in Scotland, so very little sun)!
No, we've been working hard on this chunky free update for you all, so without further ado... introducing the Ruin Remix!

This has been guided entirely by the player feedback we've received. In particular two things have been very clear: first, you wanted the Maiden's favours to keep being useful later in a run when you already have plenty of cards in your deck; and second you wanted more ruins to conquer!
So we've done those things, alongside a bunch of other balancing changes, some new cards, and a couple of bug fixes.
Full change notes below...

Once again thanks a ton to everyone who has picked up the game, if you haven't as yet had the opportunity please leave us a Steam review as that would help us immensely - the extra visibility it gives us is real, and it really helps new players discover the game!
Cheers,
James, Rachel & Tony.

notes.title: Into the Restless Ruins - Ruin Remix Update

These levels unlock when the player has reached player level 10 and has completed each corresponding standard ruin. As well as changes to the ruin layout, each remix has a unique starting deck and Charm.
Eorisdale+ - Corrupt Heart Charm
Clava Cairn+ - Bat Totem Charm
Jarlshof+ - Bad Twin Charm
Dunvegan+ - Deadly Nightshade Charm
Craigievar+ - Cracked Headstone Charm
Brodgar+ - Maiden’s Fury Charm

After a few favours The Maiden will start to offer stat boosts as a choice alongside the other cards. This makes Favours much more useful late in the run than they used to be, as you can keep your deck size small while still getting a benefit from collecting Glimour.
Wulver stocks 5 cards per night
Cards from the Wulver are all slightly cheaper to buy. These two changes make the Wulver much more useful
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938850/8317fd41013790276baaa6710c5b580a1157c43a.gif"]
Dice Den (unlocks at Player Level 6) - Allow you to spend Relics to reroll Maiden Favour choices. The Relic cost goes up every reroll, but playing more Dice Dens lowers the cost
Shortcut (PL7) - Refunds the build cost if connected to a fog room
Worm Blood (PL23) - Use: gives invincibility for a short time
Wisp’s Rest (PL12) - Use: uses up some of your torch, but gives a permanent boost to max torch
Builder’s Cache (PL16) - Refunds the build cost if connected to a corridor
Gunpowder Store (PL5) - A room full of exploding barrels, what's not to like?
Fire Pit (PL4) - A fiery version of the Poison Marsh. Cheap to play, and can be good for thinning out hordes that are following you!
Trick Deck (PL16) - On Redraw choose any 2 cards from your Draw or Discard piles to draw immediately
Broken Destiny (PL12) - Gives 3 redraws
Farsight (PL14) - Reveals 3 fog rooms
Changing Fate (PL22) - Banish 2 cards from the reward pool. Banished cards will not be offered by the Maiden, so you can shape your deck a bit more.
Still Stone - Standing still regenerates health
Corrupt Heart - Draw a curse every night. Corruption bar is half size
Bat Totem - Start lighting is smaller but burn rate is also lower
Bad Twin - 50% chance of duplicating played cards, on duplication you get +1 corruption.
Deadly Nightshade - When you’re poisoned you deal 50% extra damage
Cracked Headstone - Lose max health for every graveyard placed, reviving is more expensive
Maiden’s Fury - Every favour accepted also increases corruption by 1
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938850/540f1ec26b84cbd172cb6647800b967d65b535e6.gif"]
Blessed Light BP cost 2 -> 1
Herbal Infusion BP cost 2 -> 1
Beacon Fire BP cost 2 -> 1
Moorland BP cost 1 -> 0
Poisoned Marsh BP cost 1 -> 0
Training Room BP cost 1 -> 2
Healing Ivy heal each use 10% -> 50%
Altar health regeneration 5% -> 10% (Altar+ 10% -> 20%)
Hard Graft is no longer Sealbound
Increased health of most Wardens (sorry not sorry, but genuinely most of the feedback we got was that the Wardens are too easy to kill!)
Increased damage done by Axe, Bombs, Dirk, Firebomb, Runes, and Spear. All weapons should now be more useful and considered upgrades from the base Sword, and side-grades from each other.
Lowered density of the Horde on Brodgar
Increased the timer on high frequency Hordes so they trigger slightly less often
Lowered health and damage of some of the more extreme enemies (yeah ok those Tree Spirits Hordes were A Lot early in a Brodgar run!)
Slightly increased contrast on some UI panels
Placing a Hunter's Bothy counts itself in the number of bothies
(Nintendo Switch) Vibration on/off setting now saves correctly
Hi all, we've been reading through all of your feedback and bugs reports, on Steam, our Discord, and by using the in-game F8 report function.

We hear you that there are some balancing tweaks and other changes that you would like for later in the game, and we're thinking through how best to implement these. We don't want to rush any big balancing changes, so in the meantime we've released a small patch to fix some quicker feedback and issues that have been reported, and also adding a feature that we got asked for a lot since the demo - full mouse controls!
Full patch notes are below.

Once again thanks a ton to everyone who has picked up the game and especially anyone who's left a Steam review - they're a huge help for getting small indie teams like ours visibility, and we read every single one!
Cheers,
James, Rachel & Tony.
Into the Restless Ruins - v1.0.9 - 27/05/2025
New Updates
Added the ability to move around the ruins and interact with rooms by clicking, and rotate rooms by using Mouse 3 & 4. The whole game can be played using a mouse now.
Tweaked Maiden's Favour drafting so that corridors are less likely to draft later in a run, and so that she will sometimes draft pre-upgraded rooms later in a run.
Double Upgrade Cost and Henwife Holiday Cantrips can't be applied at the same time.
Made the currently selected Portal Gate+ route much more obvious.
Latest Fixes
Fixed some minor typos in English.
Updated Welsh translation.
Opening the Steam overlay when you're on the end of run screen no longer causes odd menu behaviour.
Feedback & bug reports include the current run save file, so we can easier reproduce reported bugs.
Fix for "Summon a Warden after running out of Torch on every night" unlock condition sometimes not triggering.
Fixed Dread multiplier calculation not saving & loading correctly.
Fix for "Harvest a warden without spending any relics" unlock condition sometimes not triggering.
Fix for very rare situation where the game would hang on startup if the primary save data corrupted, rather than restoring the backup.
